name: Akbar Sha
title: Software Developer
intro: As a software developer, I build solutions that solve complex problems, connects systems, and turn designs into working products. I enjoy what I do and the challenges that come with it.
currentlyInto: Spending time with friends and family
about: I am a software developer at Tryzens Global, working primarily across Salesforce B2C Commerce and MuleSoft integrations. Over the past three years, I have worked with three enterprise clients and 5–6 storefronts, building everything from storefront features and checkout flows to payment and third-party integrations.

Before that, I started out as a full-stack intern working with Python and Django, where I built my first applications end to end. Since then, I have earned Salesforce certifications in B2C Commerce, MuleSoft, and Agentforce, and gradually found myself drawn towards the work I enjoy most: integrations, payment flows, and solving the small technical details that make a system reliable in production.

Outside of work, I am usually watching a film, catching up on anime, playing football, or spending time with friends and family. I also enjoy building things with React and Next.js when I have an idea I want to bring to life.

projects.title: Loyalty & Engagement Integration
projects.description: Integrated Antavo Loyalty and Braze with SFCC storefronts, connecting customer and commerce events with loyalty rewards and personalised marketing journeys.
projects.challenge: Loyalty and marketing platforms lived outside the storefront, so customer engagement had to stay in sync with commerce events across multiple client sites.

projects.title: Payment Integration Cartridges
projects.description: Developed cartridges supporting multiple payment providers across production commerce environments, with a focus on secure transaction processing and reliable checkout flows.
projects.challenge: Each payment provider came with its own API contract, behaviour, and failure scenarios, all of which had to work reliably within a live checkout experience.

projects.title: MuleSoft OMS Integration Suite
projects.description: Built three to four major MuleSoft integrations connecting order management across Adobe Commerce, NewStore, AP21, 3PL, Edicom, and Avalara — covering workflows from order capture through fulfilment and tax.
projects.challenge: Multiple systems with different contracts and responsibilities had to work together around a consistent order lifecycle and continue performing reliably after launch.

contributions: Designed and delivered SFCC SFRA solutions across 3 enterprise clients and 5–6 storefronts, covering product pages, promotions, checkout flows, and payment integrations.
Integrated Antavo Loyalty and Braze marketing platforms into SFCC storefronts, enabling personalised engagement and loyalty reward flows.
Developed secure payment integration cartridges supporting multiple providers, with transaction processing designed to meet PCI requirements in production.
Architected and implemented 3–4 major MuleSoft integration builds for OMS workflows across Adobe Commerce, NewStore, AP21, 3PL, Edicom, and Avalara.
Configured and maintained SFCC jobs, services, and OCAPI endpoints to automate business processes and connect third-party systems.
Built and maintained React components for eCommerce front-ends, matching client design specifications across sprint cycles.
Completed a full-stack internship focused on Python and Django, building an e-commerce application and several CRUD web applications.
Earned the Python Web Development Expert certification from the National Council for Technology and Training through project-based learning.

beyond.title: Films
beyond.body: I watch a lot of films — anything from big-screen blockbusters to something completely unexpected. It is probably my favourite way to switch off after work.

beyond.title: Anime
beyond.body: I have always enjoyed long-form stories, and anime has more than enough of them. There is usually something new on my watchlist.

beyond.title: Football

beyond.title: Friends & Family
beyond.body: Outside of work and hobbies, most of my best time is spent with friends and family. Sometimes the best way to solve a problem is to stop thinking about it for a while.
